If you don’t feel good enough as a human being, you will try to become good enough as a human doer by for example being beautiful, doing something well, being smart, having a certain status, being spiritual, etc. Those can all be real gifts. They become a bargain for belonging when failing in these areas feels like losing yourself.
new: What is the difference between a human being and a human doing?
